You are a code worker. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files here directly. Do NOT git commit, push or touch .git. You own only: packages/worldkeeper/src/worldkeeper/model.py, storygame/runtime/item_facts.py, and tests (packages/worldkeeper/tests/*.py, tests/*.py). Edit nothing else; do not touch story data. Never weaken or delete an existing test; if one pins behaviour you must change, say so in notes.md and change only its expectation.

Problem. A companion (a character set by `set_companion`, e.g. Brandon accompanying Kristin) is treated as with the protagonist only when both have the EXACT same parent. In scene 1B the protagonist stood at the park bench (a `seat`, child of area los_angeles_park) and Brandon was placed at los_angeles_park, so (1) the narrator's THINGS line (storygame/runtime/item_facts.py ~464, `With Kristin: ...`) did not list him, and (2) worldkeeper's `World._move_companions` (model.py ~702) would not carry him when she moves on. A bench is in the park, so they ARE together. But a companion INSIDE an enclosure (the truck, a vehicle = container) while she is outside in the park is NOT together: a narrated split ('Brandon stays in the truck') must keep working, exactly as decided in W8 (docs/world-model-grounding.md, 'A companion moves with the protagonist only while it is in the same place as her').

Rule to implement, ONE shared helper. Add `World.spot(entity_id)` to worldkeeper model.py: walk the entity's ancestors starting at its parent and return the first ancestor that is an area or a container (any kind that is_a 'container', which includes vehicle), skipping ancestors that are neither (seats, supporters, furniture such as a bench or a driver seat that is itself a plain supporter). Return the entity's own area if it is an area; return None if unplaced. Then add `World.alongside(first_id, second_id)`: True when both spots are not None and equal. Use `self.chain(...)`, `_is_a(...)`, `parent(...)` as the nearby code does; read how `chain`, `area`, `together` (~lines 433-462) are written and match their style. Do not change `together` or `area`.

Use it in exactly two places: (a) `_move_companions`: carry a companion when `self.alongside(companion_id, entity_id)` is true BEFORE the leader's placement is rewritten (compute the old state first; `move` writes the leader's new placement before calling `_move_companions`, so capture what you need from `old_parent` — you may have to compute the companions to carry before `_write_placement`; keep behaviour for the existing tests in packages/worldkeeper/tests/test_regressions.py: carried when same place, not carried when the leader or companion is unplaced). (b) item_facts.py companion line: list a companion when `world.alongside(protagonist_id, companion_id)`.

Tests (hermetic, no live model): in worldkeeper tests build small worlds and assert: bench-in-area leader and companion standing in the area: alongside is True and the companion is carried when the leader moves to another area; companion inside a vehicle while the leader is in the area outside: alongside is False, the companion is NOT carried and NOT listed; leader in a seat inside the vehicle and companion in the same vehicle: True; same exact parent: True; either unplaced: False. In tests/ add a real-package test on data/stories/continuity-initiative (see tests/test_scene_1b_grounding.py `_scene_1b_state`): with brandon_identified asserted and apply_world_effects run, move kristin to park_bench, then (i) the narration THINGS block for the command 'Examine the maintenance gate.' contains 'With Kristin: Brandon.' (reuse how tests/test_bench_item_facts.py ~3113-3200 build the block) and (ii) moving kristin to kristin_truck carries brandon into kristin_truck. Existing test tests/test_scene_1b_grounding.py::test_identified_brandon_accompanies_kristin_into_the_truck must still pass unchanged.

Then run `TMPDIR=/tmp uv run pytest -q` (all pass; also run `uv run pytest packages/worldkeeper -q` if that is a separate suite) and `uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .`. Write notes.md at the worktree root: each edit with line numbers, each test, any existing expectation changed and why.
